required.name: search.query-is-literal-bounded-and-rarity-aware

required.name: search.index-is-bounded-cached-and-presentation-aware
required.outcome: one weak view-owned projection cache resolves native and custom names, distinct concise Curio primary/secondary lines, production master-item perk paths, localized Curio compact aliases such as Ability Regen, and localized semantic Health/Toughness/Wound/Stamina aliases without invoking GodRolls; raw paths, localization keys, and gameplay trait IDs remain explicitly scoped and cannot create false bare-text or visible-line relevance; full Curio description prose likewise remains available only to explicit perk clauses; every perk identity and compact alias precedes optional long Enhanced Descriptions text, so flak/unyielding and later perk slots survive the fixed 2 KB cap; bare terms use one prejoined bounded corpus while scoped fields stay distinct; normalized corpus insertion performs no duplicate normalization, bounded idle slices warm sixteen projections at a time, full presentation still detects fingerprint changes, and release retains no item references

required.name: search.ui-preserves-controller-and-utf8-input
required.outcome: Inventory 14/46, Armoury 22/34, Hadron Entreat 34/50, Melk Limited Time -40/40, and Melk Multi-Operative -40/45 defaults preserve field/card spacing and clipping; Melk top spacing uniquely accepts a bounded -50 to 64 additive correction for its large native header inset while retaining a safe scenegraph floor; sparse Melk vendor definitions are safely composed with Darktide's shared item-grid geometry before decoration, while non-equipment Mystery Acquisitions is excluded from UI decoration and update ownership; Hadron positions its field from the actual tab-frame boundary while Sacrifice retains fixed native-contract geometry; melee/ranged fields show the sword/Uncanny/Flak example while Curio inventory fields show the Toughness/Health/Revive example; cursor-mode typing leaves the native grid live for wheel scrolling and card presses, controller Up from any first-row card exclusively selects search, Confirm delegates to native platform text entry, Down returns to the current first result, and both native and GlobalStore Melk routes read Stingray's physical escape key before mapped Back suppression so the first press defocuses and the second reaches native navigation; clicking inside retains focus while any outside left-click, including empty grid space, defocuses; input-mode changes reconcile only Better Inventory-owned locks, lower rows retain native navigation, Simplified Chinese caret positions count UTF-8 codepoints, and a surviving hot-reload view delivers its visible query exactly once to the new search runtime through module-generation reconciliation

required.name: search.hooks-isolate-focused-grid-input
required.outcome: controller search focus owns only the active view's main grid through Darktide's native input-disabled state while cursor focus leaves wheel and card hotspots interactive; both modes suppress the input legend through transition-only visibility ownership without invalidating button-hint actions, controller Up is handled by supported view input hooks, and Melk owns a direct MarksVendorView input hook because Darktide copies superclass methods into child class tables before later VendorViewBase hooks; pre-disabled discard/options grids retain native ownership, newly presented cards receive one alpha refresh, no global ViewElementGrid.update, ItemGridViewBase.update, or input-legend hook charges settled inventory frames, and the Hadron-only BaseView decoration preserves every trailing native argument—including unrelated LobbyView dynamic level packages—without mutation

required.name: search.runtime-coalesces-and-releases-owned-state
required.outcome: rapid typing allocates no parser/result tables and coalesces into one settled-query scan plus one commit; Unchanged and Dim preserve strict and partial relevance in one signed weak rank map, Dim owns the live widget alpha scalar, and Hide removes only strict non-matches through the same identity-preserving double-buffered grid reorder; external layouts stably order partial ranks, cold projections warm monotonically in bounded sixteen-item slices using one reusable context without restarting on repeated captures of the same authoritative offer table, optional remembered queries occupy one bounded scalar string, and one hundred Melk-like open/query/close cycles release every index and leave no live view state

required.name: search.integration-composes-native-views-and-sorting
required.outcome: inventory, Hadron modify/sacrifice, Armoury, general weapon vendors, and equipment-bearing Melk routes map to isolated search families while cosmetics and Melk Mystery Acquisitions remain untouched; settled Unchanged, Dim, and Hide queries partition the already-sorted canonical layout by one pre-resolved scalar rank per card, preserving BetterInventory/ItemSorting/native order as the stable tie-break without invoking external comparators such as GodRolls, and double-buffer an in-place ViewElementGrid order without recreating cards; canonical membership, spacing, selection, hide-to-visible restoration, retained buffer identity, and bounded scalar maps survive repeated queries; unsupported layouts fail open to native presentation, and every adapter releases on shutdown

required.name: search.production-path-promotes-names-perks-and-blessings
